card.name: The start of discontinue
card.fires_on: The opening piece "Dis" or "dis" of the word discontinue or discontinuation, in drug-label text about stopping a medicine. It often follows "abruptly", "reduce or" or "should be".

modes.label: After abruptly or reduce or
modes.description: "dis" starts discontinue after words like abruptly or "reduction or" in dosing instructions.
modes.example: Do not rapidly reduce or abruptly<< dis>>continue tramadol hydrochloride and acet

modes.label: Capitalised heading or warning
modes.description: "Dis" or "DIS" begins discontinuation or DISCONTINUED in a section title or an all-caps warning.

card.writes: It pushes the model to finish the word with stop-related meanings such as stop, stopping and 停止.
card.plain: It fires on the first part of "discontinue" when a label talks about stopping a drug.
